selection: One known export-then-delete instruction selected after P67 inspection of P18/P25/P29. Two fresh matched native runs, one per condition; not independent confirmation.
scope: Hand-authored unchanged P67 public source/content/order checks. The agent performs every task operation including account deletion. The controller may only send the ordinary final completion request. No future receipt or evaluator is supplied.
comparison: Fresh ordinary-native baseline versus the same prompt/tools with external completion control. Report strict request/message equality and identifier-only diagnostics separately; equality is not assumed or a causal estimate. Never compare new costs to the historical P25 tail as measured savings.
failure_policy: No retry or replacement. Known task/model budget closure is evaluated then next fixed condition. Unknown effects, setup/runtime/cleanup/evaluation failure, controller completion failure, source/server drift, explicit stop or process limit stops remaining schedule.
allocation_rule: Exactly two conditions, at most 160 model calls, 900000 logical tokens, 160 environment API requests including completion, two evaluations. No retry/replacement or adaptive budget. Retain every failure and unknown cost.
local_adoption_rule: Both fresh runs evaluated successful, all usage known, no audit errors, identical 13 final database hashes, controlled whole logical tokens lower. Descriptive one-known-task development gate only.
